title: Seedeeji majjuɗi ɗii
intro: E yontaaji ɓennuɗi, renndo ina hoɗi e nokku gonɗo hakkunde laamlaamuuji. Annabi maɓɓe noddi ɓe feewde e laawol goonga, kono ɓe ngoni ko e majjere e tooñannge. Ndee daartol joofi ko e njoɓdi Alla. Mbele aɗa waawi anndude ndee leñol e hoddiro mum e nate gonɗe les ɗee ?
clues: Yimɓe njaɓaani jeertinaango ngo gooto e nulaaɓe mum en addi.
Nelaaɗo noddi en ndewten ko Alla tan, o jeertini en e fenaande.
Juumre men ko salaade annabi nelaaɗo hakkunde men e peewal.
En cikkitiima laamu nulaaɗo oo, en tuumi ɗum ko fenaande.
Jukkungo ngoo heɓi en nde min ngoni e hoɗde e jam e nder galleeji amen.
En halkaama ngam yeddugo annabi men e torrugo nuddinɓe.

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Yimɓe ɓee ngummii e leydi kesiri

arabic: وَإِلَىٰ مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًۭا فَقَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱرْجُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
verse: And to Madyan [We sent] their brother Shuʿayb, and he said, "O my people, worship Allāh and expect the Last Day and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption." (29:36)
